name: crucible
description: Keep your craft sharp: doc-discipline (cms), decision stress-testing (grill-me), a structured development workflow (develop), a safe branch lifecycle (start-branch / finish-branch), a skill-authoring guide + scaffolder (author-skill), eval-first development (freeze a baseline, gate on match-or-beat-or-revert), flag-gate (default-OFF rollout with instant revert), and loop-harness (bounded, single-threaded, read-only agent loops with budget ceilings, a LOOP-STATE ledger, and a worktree-only safety hook).
